title: Sailing to Europe in 1951 with Mezz and Hot Lips Page
summary: Dance reads Art Hodes, Bobby Hackett and Bernie Billings dates; Zutty sailed to Europe in November 1951 and played in Belgium with Mezz Mezzrow and Hot Lips Page.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Well then I've got here, (Art Hodes in Chicago 1950, Bobby Hackett '51. And that's before joining Bernie Billings in Los Angeles, is that right?
No, no. That was afterwards. Because in '51 we were in Europe.
Yes. Well the way he's got it Art Hodes, Chicago '50, Bobby Hackett Spring '51, Bernie Billings, Los Angeles, August '51, sailed to Europe in November '51.
That's right? And then you tour with Mezz?
Yes, Mezz, Lips and I we didn't play with Mezz.
We played in ( Casino la Zue ?).
